description: Fixed, versioned document-topic inference artifact. This freezes theta_d for reproducibility of all downstream PageRank/query computations. Produced by a canonical deterministic protocol: model.random_state reset to `theta_extraction_seed` immediately before extraction, documents processed in ascending doc_id (= ascending paper id) order, single documented pass -- verified empirically to make regeneration bitwise-reproducible under this exact protocol (same seed, same order, same model). This is NOT a claim that Gensim variational inference is inherently deterministic in general (ad hoc repeated calls without resetting random_state are NOT reproducible -- that non-determinism is what motivated freezing this artifact in the first place); it is a claim about this specific, documented extraction protocol only.
